deployment: The serving or edge layer generates a fresh nonce for every HTML response from a cryptographically strong source (at least nonceMinBytes random bytes, base64), never reused and never stored in source or the build.

It replaces every noncePlaceholder in index.html (the ngCspNonce attribute on the root element and the nonce attributes the build copies from it) with that nonce, and sends the policy below with {nonce} replaced by the same value.
index.html is served with Cache-Control: no-store; the hashed scripts and styles may be cached.

A deployment adds its own origins (for example the runtime-config backend origins in connect-src) without widening script-src or style-src. A profile that cannot provide a per-response nonce is a security exception that needs PO/SA disposition.
